title: A Mouse Without Confidence
simplified_paragraphs: 森林中有一只小老鼠，它觉得自己形象不佳，本领又小，生活在社会的最底层。于是，它来到山神面前，再三哀求山神把它变成一只猫，山神答应了它的要求。小老鼠变成猫后，没高兴几天，又有了新的问题，原来猫怕狗呀！它又去求山神，把自己变成了一只狗。可是没想到狗怕狼，于是小老鼠又跑去请求变成狼。像这样变了好多次后，小老鼠终于变成了大象。现在，动物们都怕它了，它高兴极了。但是一段时间后，小老鼠发现，大象最怕的竟然是老鼠。这时它眼中最伟大的形象又变成了老鼠，于是它又跑去哀求山神……
羡慕别人是没有用的，因为每个人都有弱点。只有自信，才有勇气打败竞争对手。
traditional_paragraphs: 森林中有一隻小老鼠，它覺得自己形象不佳，本領又小，生活在社會的最底層。於是，它來到山神面前，再三哀求山神把它變成一隻貓，山神答應了它的要求。小老鼠變成貓後，沒高興幾天，又有了新的問題，原來貓怕狗呀！它又去求山神，把自己變成了一隻狗。可是沒想到狗怕狼，於是小老鼠又跑去請求變成狼。像這樣變了好多次後，小老鼠終於變成了大象。現在，動物們都怕它了，它高興極了。但是一段時間後，小老鼠發現，大象最怕的竟然是老鼠。這時它眼中最偉大的形象又變成了老鼠，於是它又跑去哀求山神……
羨慕別人是沒有用的，因為每個人都有弱點。只有自信，才有勇氣打敗競爭對手。

english_paragraphs: There was a little mouse in the forest who thought it looked unimpressive and had few abilities. It felt it was at the very bottom of the animal world. So it went to the mountain god and begged him again and again to turn it into a cat. The mountain god agreed. But just a few days after becoming a cat, the little mouse had a new problem: cats were afraid of dogs! It went back to the mountain god and asked to be turned into a dog. Then it discovered that dogs were afraid of wolves, so it hurried back and asked to become a wolf. After changing into many different animals, the little mouse finally became an elephant. Now all the animals were afraid of it, and it was delighted. But after a while, it discovered that what elephants feared most was mice. Suddenly, the animal it admired most was a mouse again, so it ran back to beg the mountain god once more...
There is no use envying others, because everyone has weaknesses. Only by believing in yourself can you find the courage to defeat your rivals.
english_full:
There was a little mouse in the forest who thought it looked unimpressive and had few abilities. It felt it was at the very bottom of the animal world. So it went to the mountain god and begged him again and again to turn it into a cat. The mountain god agreed. But just a few days after becoming a cat, the little mouse had a new problem: cats were afraid of dogs! It went back to the mountain god and asked to be turned into a dog. Then it discovered that dogs were afraid of wolves, so it hurried back and asked to become a wolf. After changing into many different animals, the little mouse finally became an elephant. Now all the animals were afraid of it, and it was delighted. But after a while, it discovered that what elephants feared most was mice. Suddenly, the animal it admired most was a mouse again, so it ran back to beg the mountain god once more...

There is no use envying others, because everyone has weaknesses. Only by believing in yourself can you find the courage to defeat your rivals.
